rules: Use Chivo for all headers (H1-H4) to provide a solid, utilitarian, commanding structure.
Use IBM Plex Sans for body text to ensure maximum legibility at high data density.
Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for numerical data, coordinates, risk scores, node IDs, and KPIs to create a raw, terminal-like operational feel.
CRITICAL: Banned fonts include Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato.

colors.archetype: The Tactical Command Center / High-Contrast Swiss

background.rule: Never use pure white or light grey modes. This is a mission-critical dark environment. Do NOT use transparent backgrounds in dropdowns/headers.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders ('Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. High-density dashboards must have a visible grid structure. Use 1px solid borders (`border-border`) between sections. NO soft shadows. NO glassmorphism for data panels (it reduces clarity). 2-4px border radius at most.
visual_enhancers.motion: Reactive & State-Driven. Minimalist animation. Avoid bouncy or long transitions. Use micro-interactions for feedback (e.g., instant 0.1s color shifts on hover). Critical alerts use a rapid 'heartbeat' pulse animation on the map or KPI card.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Dense & Compact. Rely on Tailwind `p-2`, `p-3`, `p-4` inside widget cards. Maximize vertical space. Use full screen (`100vw`, `100vh`) with no scrolling where possible.

layouts.dashboard_layout: Three-panel 'F-shaped' hierarchy based on Palantir patterns: Left panel (20% width) for Navigation, Entity Lists & Filters. Center panel (50% width) for Map and Graph visualizations. Right panel (30% width) for Context, AI Risk Scores, and deep-dive Case Details.
layouts.bento_density: High Density Grid. Base grid `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12`. Gaps should be tight (`gap-[1px]` inside a border-collapse container). Every pixel must be utilized for data projection.

components.kpi_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, sharp corners. Monospace numbers for values. Tiny uppercase overlines for labels (`tracking-[0.2em]`). Include a micro-sparkline using Recharts.
components.map_view: Dark tactical style. Map container MUST fill its parent grid slot completely. Overlay scatterplot or heatmap layer. Use pulsing circles for hotspots utilizing the `risk_gradient.critical` color.
components.network_graph: Node-link graph. Nodes represent Suspects (Red), Victims (Green), Locations (Blue). Lines represent links. Background must be transparent `#00000000` to blend with the UI surface.
components.tables: Dense rows. Sticky headers. Monospace font for IDs, Dates, and Coordinates. Status badges using risk gradient colors with 10% opacity backgrounds and 1px borders.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components but strip the generic Vercel look. Hard angles (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Distinct focus rings using tactical blue.

libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular for dense data tools, avoiding 'corporate tech' default look)
libraries.maps: react-simple-maps or leaflet (react-leaflet) with dark-mode tile provider

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Deep black background requires off-white text (`#E6EDF3`). Avoid pure white to reduce eye strain.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="risk-score-card"`, `data-testid="filter-district-select"`).

login_background.description: Tactical dark map screen, highly suitable for a low-opacity background behind a serious login prompt.

network_abstract.description: Abstract network graph points. Can be used for link analysis blank state or predictive AI loading screens.

mock_data_guidance.scenarios: Simulate a 'Red-zone' alert in Bengaluru Urban (high density of Cybercrime) and an emerging narcotics hotspot in Mangaluru.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use standard Shadcn round cards. Override border-radius to 2px or 4px.
DO NOT use Inter or Roboto. Inject Chivo, IBM Plex Sans, and JetBrains Mono.
Implement the Palantir F-shaped layout: Nav/Filters on Left, Visualization in Center, Deep Dive/Action on Right.
Use grid lines to separate sections rather than floating cards on a grey background. This is a tactical command center.
Implement a 'Pulse' animation on high-risk map nodes using Framer Motion.
Use Phosphor Icons. Do not use generic emoji or Vercel default icons.
Use Recharts with dark-mode styling (remove axis lines, use dotted grid lines).
Ensure the entire app is wrapped in a dark theme by default, with `bg-[#06080A] text-[#E6EDF3]` on the root element.
Avoid purple-gradient AI-slop completely. Rely on the pure, strict colors defined in the risk_gradient.
Use actual JavaScript (.js/.jsx), do not write TypeScript (.tsx) as specified by environment rules.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but prefer solid colored borders for data-dense apps over shadow blobs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }`.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Use sonner for toasts, located in `/app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js`.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
